sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Buddha Prakash
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Rajesh Kumar Jaiswal

Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,Acting Chief Justice
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.
The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioner for excess land taken over by them for construction of a National Highway.
2. Concededly, certain part of the land of the petitioner was acquired under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956.

His case is that the respondents had taken possession of excess land than what was notified for acquisition and there are contradictory reports of the Authorities in relation to the extent of area taken in excess.

In support of the above contention, the petitioner Ramphal Singh vs Project Director And 3 Others on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120771773/
1 places reliance on a communication between the Project Director, N.H.A.I and Deputy District Magistrate, Tehsil Khekara, District Baghpat and another communication dated 06.10.2023.

entities.text: Ramphal Singh vs Project Director And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents and Shri R.K. Jaiswal for N.H.A.I. submit that the aforesaid dispute has to be decided by the District Level Committee in terms of the Government Order dated 12.05.2016.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner is agreeable to the said proposal.

5. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits, the petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to make fresh representation alongwith true attested copy of the instant order before respondent No.2 within two weeks from today and, in which event, respondent No.2 will transmit the representation to the Chairperson of the District Level Committee for being decided in terms of the Government Order dated 12.05.2016 within next twelve weeks after providing opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and carrying out fresh survey of the land in question.
